top_signal.title: Started strong, now radio silence on payment. Is this normal or a red flag I'm missing?
top_signal.summary: I'm an independent consultant, I implement CRM systems and other tools around it for small businesses: accounting, photographers, accountants, consultancies, agencies. And I charge $60/hr.   Lately I've had two cases that have me second guessing things. One client with a 6 months relationship went completely silent weeks after I sent the last invoice; nothing, not even an excuse. Another wanted to start right away, urgent, the moment we first talked; paid the retainer, and now that it's time to pay for the next round, I keep getting delay after delay.   It's making me wonder if the rate is the problem: does $60/hr sound low enough that people don't take it seriously? Or is it more about the type of client I'm landing (in this case both of them are in Miami), separate from the price?   Has this happened to anyone else here? Does raising your rate actually filter out clients like this, or is it something else that needs to change?       submitted by     /u/alcides86       [link]       [comments]
